question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

INTERFERE
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Advance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of the word "**INTERFERE**" is: **ADVANCE**.
 
• "**Interfere**" means **to intrude or intervene in a situation, often causing disruptions or hindrances.** It implies getting involved in a way that negatively impacts the progress or normal functioning of something.
